# lynxcms/cache

> 标签: PHP

## 简介

Page cache for Lynx CMS: guest pages stored as HTML, served by the web server or before Laravel's session starts, and cleared when content changes.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。
